source.article: VectorForge says its new index cut median query latency from 40ms to 20ms on one million 768-dimensional vectors, using one client on a 64GB machine. Recall stayed at 95%. The index used 48GB, up from 24GB. The team has released the benchmark script but has not tested concurrent clients. The release is a prototype.

source.title: LedgerCloud changes its pricing
source.article: LedgerCloud will replace its $20 monthly developer plan with a $5 base fee plus $1 per thousand API calls on November 1. The company says 60% of current accounts make fewer than 10,000 calls a month. Existing annual contracts keep their price until renewal. Usage alerts arrive at 80% of a customer-set budget; they do not stop requests. Customers can set a hard cap, which rejects excess requests.

source.article: Helio released a quantized build of its language model on Friday. In Helio's batch-one test, GPU memory fell from 32GB to 20GB, while throughput fell from 130 to 110 tokens per second. The test used one A100 GPU and English prompts. The weights are available under Apache 2.0.
